text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Hearing things from a goddess 
statue? Maybe I'm just stressed...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. The three of them huddling close 
together, huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We should strive to be like that as well, 
shouldn't we?
